speaker: john_heminges
text: The end is played. I am not opening the boxes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday. I have a supper at six, and I do not want a sum in my head before I have heard a man.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Thou wilt hear a countryman, and the jig has had me. Eight minutes, and I am off the stage. That is the whole of my interest today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The tally stays shut, Will. I am not asking Abel to open it for a jig.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. John, I have not forgotten tomorrow. God give you the evening. I will say the day in the morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Go and be charitable to one man, then. Thou art no good at it in company.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Six. Do not bring the boxes into it.
